checks.name: 16 direction semantics and cardinals
checks.evidence: Visually inspected all labeled poses in directions.png, including the enlarged eye crops. 000 is up, 090 screen-right, 180 down, and 270 screen-left. Intermediate gaze offsets follow the labeled quadrants.

checks.name: Body scale and proportions
checks.evidence: The contact sheet retains the same round clock face, slender limbs, gloves and shoes throughout. The failed pose deliberately lowers/slumps the body; jump limbs tuck without an unrelated head or body scale.

checks.name: Silhouette-following glow
checks.evidence: Current native-dark-light.png shows an amber halo following the clock, gloves and shoes against both dark and light backgrounds. The fade is visually smooth enough for the pixel artwork at the displayed scale; no objectionable hard alpha rings or large contour discontinuities are visible.

checks.name: No square field or stray dirt
checks.evidence: No opaque rectangular field or detached specks are visible in the refreshed composites/contact sheet. Background remains clear outside the silhouette and halo.

checks.name: Jump takeoff and landing
checks.evidence: The refreshed jumping contact-sheet row retains grounded frame 00, rising frame 01, highest frame 02, descending frame 03 and grounded frame 04. Limbs remain readable and unclipped. Earlier individual-frame inspection established the same pose sequence; timing is not established.

checks.name: Animation family consistency
checks.evidence: All nine refreshed state rows retain the same orange/gold clock design, readable dark face and limb outlines, cream gloves, gold shoes and amber glow. Running directions mirror coherently; distinct gestures remain recognizable as the same character. The reduced palette remains readable in the displayed pixel style.

checks.name: Fine directional discrimination at small size
checks.evidence: Adjacent 22.5-degree gaze steps differ subtly at the small contact-sheet scale. Their quadrants and cardinal directions are clear in the larger labeled sheet; this review does not establish that every adjacent step will be distinguishable at every application display scale.

checks.name: Repaired upper dial rim encoding
checks.evidence: In the current dark/light running and jumping poses, the upper rim reads warm amber/gold around the intentional brown dial outline. No separate gray strip above or below the upper dial edge is visible. The refreshed contact sheet agrees. Pixel stair-steps remain consistent with the artwork style.

warnings: Adjacent gaze steps are subtle at small size.
Review covers rendered still frames and contact sheets. Animation timing, loop smoothness and native application playback were not exercised.
review_surface: Current final-encoding native-dark-light.png, directions.png and contact-sheet.png. The refreshed contact sheet confirms grounded/rise/apex/descent/grounded jump pose order; timing and native playback remain untested.
encoding_context: Parent reports independent RGB32 palette and 32 alpha levels, with body alpha 204. This is visual QA of rendered images; full original alpha preservation is not claimed.
